**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The Agreement imposes no non-compete, field-of-use, territory or exclusivity restriction on Clear Capital:

- **§1 (Purpose of Engagement)** and **§6 (Termination)** — the planner's candidate sections — contain only scope-of-services, personnel, change-order and termination mechanics. Nothing limits the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build.
- **Targeted searches** for "compet", "exclusiv", "solicit", "similar services", "restrict" and "Company shall not" surfaced only three provisions, none of which is a restrictive covenant on us:
  - **p0020 (§4)** — "Company shall not resell or make use of said property in any other manner other than in connection with the software Company receives under this Agreement." This is a licence-scope limit on RadialSpark's pre-existing proprietary materials, not a restraint on our business activities. It is also softened by the perpetual, sublicensable licence in p0021.
  - **p0047 (§13)** — a mutual employee non-solicit (term plus one year, limited to personnel with direct Services involvement, consent not unreasonably withheld). Reciprocal and a personnel restriction, so outside this rule.
  - **p0056** — "court of competent jurisdiction," a false positive.

No obligation binding us restricts competing products or fields of use, so the preferred position is already achieved and the fallback narrowing language is unnecessary.
